scenarios.fact: Exact rooms, sources, embeddings, and personas exist.
Authorized upload, metadata, delivery, and deletion preserve ownership.
Mallory cannot retrieve sources, search results, questions, answers, or progress.
Keyword search returns the frozen expected source set.
Semantic retrieval uses the provider's ordinary path or is explicit GAP.
A question produces four authoritative progress updates before completion.
The answer retains valid citations to authorized source records.
Bob observes Alice's progress live through the attributed path.
Confirmed cancellation prevents every late durable patch.
Retry is idempotent and does not duplicate question or answer.
Complete, failed, cancelled, timed-out, and ambiguous effects remain distinct.
Scheduled refresh fetches a deterministic external source and records progress once.
Secrets remain server-side and are absent from clients, logs, receipts, and diagnostics.
Frozen search/write/progress/reconnect/deploy samples and cost window are retained.
Only exact fresh targets or arm-owned namespaced records, files, schedules, and secrets are retired; unrelated baseline state is preserved.
